messages:
tasha: Quick recon: whos coming to tonights 'Whitespace Therapy' session? Bring your feelings about tabs. :thermometer:
omar: I'll be there. I have unresolved issues with a YAML file from 2019. :cry:
ridley: Showing up with SemVer confessions: I once shipped 2.0.0 and called it a "minor" update. :see_no_evil:
build-bot: Lint report: 1 file with tabs in YAML; please fix before merge.
tasha: @ridley thats grounds for public apology and a printed changelog recital. :scroll:
omar: Prize for best apology: a sticker that reads "I respect semver (mostly)".
ridley: I accept the sticker and will read my changelog in interpretive dance. :man_dancing:
tasha: OK official rule: anyone causing a parser error buys snacks. Deal? :chipmunk:
build-bot: Reminder: kitchen closes at 7pm. Event starts at 7:30pm.
